title: The Cushion for the Long Story
youtube_title: The Cushion for the Long Story | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who helped, and helping back, keeps a home kind.
summary: At a bedroom with the hall light still on, Cosima notices that Grandma Nia has already taken care of a cushion set out because the story would be long. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Cosima does one useful thing Grandma Nia did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
